summary: Boost your tourism business with our Email Marketing Campaigns training course. Learn strategies to engage customers and drive bookings effectively!
lede: Tourism email marketing helps travel and hospitality teams send relevant messages that guide subscribers toward booking. The course is for tourism professionals responsible for marketing, reservations, or customer relationships. Participants learn to build permission-based lists, segment audiences by interests and booking behavior, create automated follow-up sequences, write engaging email copy, and assess campaign performance through clicks, conversions, and revenue measures.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who are pivotal in driving bookings and guest engagement through email marketing.
audience: CRM and database managers in tourism organizations
modules: Foundations of Email Marketing for Tourism
Building and Growing Your Email List
Crafting Subject Lines and Preview Text That Get Opened
Writing Email Copy That Inspires and Converts
Automated Email Sequences for the Booking Journey
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of digital marketing principles and access to an email marketing platform.
